summary: Comprehensive testing of InfoPilot Explorer social features (iteration 7) completed. Fixed critical MongoDB collection boolean testing bug in reactions/comments APIs. All 22 backend API tests passed (100%). All UI flows verified working correctly. FEATURES VERIFIED: 1) Groups with posts, reactions (6 emoji types), and comments. 2) Pages with posts, reactions, and comments. 3) Updates section on Ultimate Search page with reactions and comments. 4) Ultimate Search page rename functionality. 5) Facebook-style emoji picker (like, love, haha, wow, sad, angry) working on hover.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: MongoDB collection boolean testing bug - Changed 'if not collection:' to 'if post_type not in collection_map:' in 4 API endpoints (add_reaction, remove_reaction, get_reactions, add_comment)
MongoDB collection objects don't support truth value testing (bool()) - must use 'is None' or 'in' checks instead
seed_data_creation: Created test groups, pages, posts, reactions, comments, and updates during testing - all test data prefixed with TEST_
context_for_next_testing_agent: All social features thoroughly tested and working. Key verifications completed: 1) GROUPS: Create group (public/private/secret), create post, add reactions (6 types), add comments with replies. 2) PAGES: Create page with category, create post, add reactions, add comments. 3) UPDATES: Post updates on Ultimate Search page, add reactions, add comments. 4) REACTIONS: Facebook-style emoji picker (like, love, haha, wow, sad, angry) shows on hover. 5) COMMENTS: Nested replies supported. 6) RENAME PAGE: Ultimate Search page name customization working.
